name: Iwasaki Azusa
source:
A simple girl raised in the countryside. Was deeply impressed by erotic games during her school days. However, she couldn't come out to her classmates and moved to Tokyo after graduation. Sent her resume to her dream company, Piyopiyo Soft, and was successfully hired. 
She moved to Tokyo against her family's wishes, so she can't easily go back home. Looks plain at first glance, but upon closer inspection, she's cute and busty. Completely unaware of her own appeal.
